skill.displayName: AdsTurbo 视频改造 · AdsTurbo Video Transform

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed AdsTurbo video-transformation wrapper, with expected remote media upload behavior and no evidence of hidden persistence or malicious actions.

dimensions.detail: The skill sends user-provided URLs and explicitly selected local upload files to AdsTurbo, returning public URLs; this is proportionate to the media transformation purpose but should be understood by users.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package installation is required; scripts use the Python standard library and a user-provided ADSTURBO_API_KEY.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation phrases are somewhat broad, but the skill documents boundaries and specifically tells the agent to confirm whether video translation means re-dubbing or subtitles.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No startup hooks, background services, memory writes, privilege escalation, shell execution, or persistent local modification were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill transforms videos by character swap, motion control, or re-dubbed translation using AdsTurbo APIs; this matches its stated purpose, though it can process personal likeness and voice-like media.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending selected videos, images, and related media URLs to AdsTurbo for processing. Avoid uploading sensitive, private, regulated, or unauthorized likeness/voice content unless you accept that the upload becomes externally accessible and subject to AdsTurbo's handling and billing terms.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Broad trigger language is partly mitigated by capability boundaries and a specific confirmation step for translation versus subtitles; this is a usability risk, not evidence of hidden or malicious behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Uploading local media and making it available as a public URL is clearly part of the documented AdsTurbo workflow, though stronger privacy warnings would be advisable for sensitive media.
[SQP-3] expected: Language re-dubbing is an explicit user-directed feature with a required target language argument; no automatic or undisclosed locale behavior was found.
